turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase, especially with something living like a plant.

A few things about quality here that might help:

We grow all of our own plants at our nurseries in Oregon; we don’t buy in from third-party growers.
Roses are own-root in 1-gallon containers (not bare root), which means they’re grown on their own roots for long-term strength and better recovery if they’re ever stressed or cut back.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and perennials have a 90-day guarantee, so you’re not on your own if something doesn’t establish well.
Plants are defoliated before shipping so they travel better, then leaf out again once planted and settled in.

If you tell me:

What you’re looking for (rose vs other perennial, color, fragrance, size, special meaning, etc.)
Your planting zone or city/ZIP
How much sun the spot gets

I can help you pick something that really fits your situation, not just “whatever is pretty on the page.”
